theorems.name: Endpoint sum is a twisted coboundary
theorems.statement: For the K4 sign local system transporting integer coefficients by -1 on every edge, the twisted coboundary is d(v)_ij=v_j-(-1)v_i=v_i+v_j, exactly the endpoint-sum map.

theorems.name: Uniformly twisted cohomology type
theorems.statement: The ordinary K4 incidence matrix has Smith factors (1,1,1), while the uniform sign-twisted incidence matrix has factors (1,1,1,2); hence the respective one-cochain quotients are Z^3 and Z^2 plus Z/2.
theorems.status: EXACT DETERMINANTAL-DIVISOR CHECKER + EXISTING ENDPOINT RESIDUAL PROOF
theorems.boundary: The new Lean module proves the structural identities and kernel contrast; Smith normal form is certified by exact minors in the executable checker and by the pre-existing endpoint residual ledger.

theorems.name: Odd-cycle removal of parallel sections
theorems.statement: The flat incidence kernel consists of constant vertex sections, whereas the uniformly reversing sign system has no nonzero integral parallel section because a triangular odd cycle forces v=-v.

theorems.name: Characteristic-two coincidence
theorems.statement: The ordinary oriented and uniformly twisted incidence maps become equal modulo two; this is the integral origin of the mod-two holonomy-residual duality.

theorems.name: Zero-total neutral-sector exact sequence
theorems.statement: The precision endpoint residual Q0=E0/d(V0) injects as the kernel of total edge mass modulo three in the full twisted one-cochain quotient, giving 0 -> Q0 -> coker(d) -> Z/3 -> 0.
theorems.status: MANUSCRIPT CONSTRUCTIVE PROOF + LEAN CORE IDENTITIES + EXACT CHECKER

theorems.name: Two fully symmetric chirality phases
theorems.statement: The only S4-fixed graph-gauge classes are the flat zero class and the uniformly twisted all-face-flip class; tetrahedral symmetry alone therefore does not force face-flatness.

theorems.name: Unique nonzero symmetric root-kernel bridge
theorems.statement: A fully S4-equivariant homomorphism from the trivial C2 root-cover kernel to the mod-two endpoint residual is either zero or the unique nonzero map whose generator lands in endpoint torsion.

theorems.name: Projective Euler twisted phase
theorems.statement: In the uniformly twisted phase a global signed J does not exist over the filled faces, but chirality-even observables such as the half-period endpoint, norm, cosine channel, polygonal bounds, and scalar precision-pi readouts descend.
theorems.status: DERIVED FROM EMECR-T08 AND THE UNIFORM TWIST IDENTIFICATION

resolved_boundary: The endpoint-sum residual now has an integral interpretation as the graph one-cochain quotient for the unique fully S4-symmetric uniformly reversing sign local system; the mod-two Euler/endpoint bridge is its characteristic-two shadow.
